description: This file defines the AuditLogRepository class, which handles database operations related to audit logs. It includes methods for retrieving, counting, and inserting audit log records, utilizing prepared statements and SQL query builders.

classes.name: AuditLogRepository
classes.description: Repository class for CRUD operations on audit log data, extending MysqlRepository, with methods for retrieving, counting, and inserting logs.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all audit log entries with pagination, returning an array of records.

methods.name: countAll
methods.description: Returns the total count of audit log entries.

methods.name: findByUserId
methods.description: Fetches audit logs created by a specific user ID.

methods.name: findCountByDayStats
methods.description: Returns daily statistics of audit logs, grouped by date.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new audit log entry into the database.

methods.name: getBaseSelectQueryBuilder
methods.description: Constructs and returns a base SelectQueryBuilder object customized for audit logs.
